name: empty-state
title: Empty State
summary: What a list, a table or a popup shows when there is nothing in it.
description: What a list, a table or a popup shows when there is nothing in it: an optional icon, a title, an optional hint and an optional action (the real Button the host passes: "New issue", "Clear filters"). A row sits in a list like one of its rows; a block is a centred stack for a popup or a table body. It fades in when it appears.

anatomy.description: data-size, data-align. The host toggles it with `hidden`. Extra attributes (hidden, id, role, aria-*) land on it in every target, so a host toggles it with hidden.

aria-hidden. Row: 14px ink-3 glyph. Block: a 32px tile in the hover grey with a soft hairline (line-soft) and a 15px glyph: quiet in both themes (in dark mode an inset tile read as a hole with a bright ring).

What to do next, passed by the host (React: action, a node; Vue: slot action; Svelte: snippet action), usually one Button (sm). Block: centred under the text, 14px below it. Row: at the end of the line.

icon.description: A name from the icon vocabulary (spec/icons.json), one of magnifying-glass, funnel, chats, folder-open, table, file, bell, check-circle, users, rocket-launch, list-checks, git-branch (the adapters type the prop to these names); or your own icon (React element, Vue slot `icon`, Svelte snippet). Any other string draws nothing: a name is never rendered as text.

size.description: row: one line as tall as the list's rows (--option-height, 30px by default), 12px ink-2. block: a centred stack, 13px/500 ink title, 12px ink-2 hint, padding 32/16.

align.description: Rows only: start the line with the list's text, or centre it (a message in a card or under a filter). A block is always centred.

action.description: What to do next: a Button (or two). React: a node; Vue: the action slot; Svelte: a snippet.

slots.icon: Vue: your own icon in place of the named ones (React: icon as a node; Svelte: icon as a snippet).
slots.action: Vue: what to do next (a Button), under a block's text or at the end of a row (React: action as a node; Svelte: action as a snippet).

notes: The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title says what is empty.

When the empty state replaces results the user is typing for, announce it from the host's own status region (search and prompt-bar already have one); the empty state does not carry role=status, so it is never announced twice.
Inside a listbox, keep it outside the options (it is not an option).
The action is an ordinary Button in the tab order; its label says what it does ("New issue", not "Get started").

motion: enter: opacity 0 -> 1 over duration.base ease when it appears, also out of `hidden` (@starting-style)
exit: none; it goes when results arrive
notes: Replaces the hand-made empty states in search, prompt-bar, filter-table, records-table, insight-cards and sidebar-nav: the host keeps its spacing through its own class (a table cell's height, a card's inset background).
